title: Rava, Brother or Father of Rav Mari bar Rachel
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Shabbat 154a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.154a.4); see also the entry Rav Mari bar Rachel.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara gives Rava as Rav Mari bar Rachel’s brother, with father as an alternative. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3172&lang=en) records the same kinship alternatives under Rabbah. The Gemara itself raises the possibility of two people named Rav Mari bar Rachel.
